# LEVEL — Turkish magazine review

- Original source: [LEVEL — Turkish magazine review](https://eu-southeast-2a.s3.dt.net.tr/level300/Level_Ocak-2003.pdf)
- Author / publication: Güven Çatak / LEVEL
- Language / date: Turkish; January 2003 issue, printed page 50
- Access: Substantial indexed PDF passage inspected; direct PDF retrieval failed
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Çatak recommends the game to players who enjoyed Desperados and squad-based tactics. The review emphasizes how training and resource management expand the established formula.

The opening missions are described as relatively linear, with the Sherwood camp subsequently introducing optional operations and a stronger feeling of directing the campaign. Forest raids serve ransom collection and experience, while larger story missions involve infiltration, rescue, meetings, and the archery tournament.

The article also links sparing enemies to increased recruitment. Only the indexed passage was inspected, so no numerical score or complete page range is inferred. This record adds contemporary Turkish reception rather than a modern recollection.
